title: docs(pm-skill): the seventh readings increment — seven landed lines, one in-place correction, and a NON-reproduction
body:
Fixes #16641
Fixes #16703

Governed surface (`.claude/**`) — draft only. No seat flips this ready, enqueues it, or arms auto-merge (Prime Directive #14). `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the two changed paths exits **3 GOVERNED**, verdict line: `⛔ GOVERNED — a human merge is the review record for this PR (#9495 regime).`

Ledger **395 → 402 (+7)** under the STANDING one-file exception; ceiling row and a `ruledRaises` record moved with it.

> **Patch round applied.** Seat review found that delivering #16703 as an in-place rewrite cost the read-side row its SUBJECT. That row is now restored **byte-identical** to `origin/main` and the title fact pays for its own line. Details in section 2; the accounting moved +6 → +7 with it.

---

## 1. The carrier card's primary judgement: the single-label omission did NOT reproduce

The card required a single-label `list_issues` re-measured against a control read on a label with a KNOWN member, and ruled in advance that a non-reproduction lands **no line**. It did not reproduce, so **no line was written for it**.

This container's repo-scoped REST is **403** — probed first, not assumed: `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/16641` answered `403 GitHub access is not enabled for this session`. So the control channel is `search_issues` with qualifiers, as the card's second option allows.

**Group 1 — objectui, `pm:retriage`, open. 2026-09-08T03:37Z**

| | population | result |
|:---|:---|:---|
| subject | `list_issues` objectui `labels: [pm:retriage]` state OPEN | `totalCount: 5`, `hasNextPage: false`, rows == totalCount: 8444, 8390, 8388, 8126, 8115 |
| control | `search_issues` query `repo:objectstack-ai/objectui is:open label:pm:retriage` | `total_count: 5`, `incomplete_results: false`: 8444, 8390, 8388, 8126, 8115 |

Sets IDENTICAL. Every row carries `pm:retriage` in its own returned label array.

**Group 2 — objectstack, `domain:skills`, open. 2026-09-08T03:36Z**

| | population | result |
|:---|:---|:---|
| subject | `list_issues` objectstack `labels: [domain:skills]` state OPEN | `totalCount: 17`, `hasNextPage: false`, rows == totalCount |
| control A | `search_issues` query `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:open label:domain:skills` | `total_count: 17`, same 17 numbers |
| control B (known member) | `issue_read get` on 16641 and on 16703, both at 03:3xZ | both return `domain:skills` in `labels`; both PRESENT in the listing |

Sets IDENTICAL: 16747, 16706, 16703, 16688, 16655, 16653, 16641, 16633, 16149, 15275, 14881, 14343, 14292, 13658, 13597, 13417, 11742.

Control B is the card's own bar — a label with a member established through a channel that is not the listing. The specimen the card was opened for (objectui 7780 carrying `pm:retriage` in 2026-09-07) could not be re-run: the seat had already recorded at 15:38Z that the card no longer carries that label.

⇒ **Non-reproduction at n=2 groups, on a card that ruled a non-reproduction closes with the reading.** The negative reading and both controls are on the card.

## 2. The second card — one restored row, one NEW row

⭐ **This is the patch round, and the distinction is the whole finding.** The first attempt replaced the read-side row in place. That row's job is to name **what** is discarded — an angle-bracketed span inside inline backticks, discarded **whole**, **unescaped**, **undecodable** — which is the load-bearing contrast with the entity-escaping row above it, the one loss that IS reversible. Replacing it left 「丢弃」 with no antecedent anywhere in the file, and no other row carries that fact (the row at 220 is about a standalone marker line in a COMMENT, a different surface).

So the read-side row is **restored byte-identical to `origin/main`** (blob `c242297575d3c04205e47d9628ff0545e5d63da4`, verified with `cmp` against `git show 7c12e475e:...`), and the title fact lands as its own adjacent row:

```
- 读侧并非一律可逆:行内反引号里的尖括号片段被 MCP 读路径整个丢弃,非转义,无从解码。   ← restored, 118 bytes
- 该丢弃亦及标题:自首个 tag 形跨度截到尾,是切不是洞 ⇒ 凭标题的总体计数只是下界。      ← NEW, 116 bytes
```

The new row opens with an explicit antecedent (`该丢弃`) and carries the four things that card measured: the loss is on the READ side, it reaches TITLES, it is a **cut to the end** and not a hole, and a title-derived population count is therefore only a lower bound. The card's own prohibition is honoured — the repair is NOT "stop writing angle brackets", because the bytes are correct in storage.

The false CREATE-path attribution row that card also named was already removed by PR 16701; verified absent on `origin/main` before editing, so it is not edited twice.

## 3. Rider dedup — candidate / landed / already-present / refused

Each rider was grepped against the ledger with a Chinese and an English keyword, each zero-hit grep carrying a positive control that hit.

**Rider candidates: 9. Landed: 6. Already present: 3. Refused: 1 (withdrawn upstream).** Plus the #16703 title row above ⇒ **7 landed lines total.**

| # | reading | verdict | evidence |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 1 | dispatch-gates self-test runs past the container's 600 s foreground cap | **landed** | zero hits for the cap and for `tail --pid`; positive control `sleep` hit line 359. Re-measured below. |
| 2 | a push re-folding an armed PR can drop the arm, no field saying so | **landed** | zero hits; adjacent rows 14/36/126 are re-arming in other contexts, not this trigger |
| 3 | `draft:false` then arm, queue ref within 4 min | **already present** | line 76 already sets the polling budget at 1-3 min / budget 3 min; a 4-min observation is consistent with it and weaker, so it adds no prescription |
| 4 | `enable_pr_auto_merge` succeeds on an already-`clean` PR, against its own tool description | **landed** | zero hits; rows 52-53 are about the reply ECHO, not the precondition |
| 5 | `search_pull_requests` returns PR labels | **landed**, re-measured and widened | the block declares three read legs all blind. Measured: BOTH PR-native MCP endpoints return full `labels` |
| 6 | the arm reply's `method` reads MERGE for a SQUASH request | **already present** | line 47 verbatim: `它存的方法恒为 merge,不论请求了什么`. The empty/populated instability is line 52. Fully covered. |
| 7 | `issue_write update` takes a PR number for `labels` + `assignees` | **landed** | zero hits; it is the write-side mirror of read leg ① refusing PR numbers |
| 8 | `list_pull_requests` returns `merged: false` with `merged_at` set | **already present** (line 21) — its `merged_by` half **landed** | re-measured, below |
| 9 | `update_pull_request` with reviewers + explicit `draft: true` leaves the draft bit alone | **already present** | lines 39-42 already prescribe exactly this call for an MCP-only seat; the reading CONFIRMS a standing prescription rather than adding a fact |
| 10 | a reviewers-bearing `update_pull_request` flips a governed draft to ready | **refused** | withdrawn by the seat mid-flight: the PR event log named a human actor's APPROVED plus auto-merge at 03:49:17Z as the flip, not the review-request call. Written, then fully reverted; the remedy row it had rewritten is restored byte-identical. |

### The riders re-measured in this container

**Rider 1 — CONFIRMED, and BOTH numeric figures deliberately kept OUT of the line.** `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, foreground: started 03:45:54Z, exited 03:57:39Z — **705 s wall, exit 0**. The harness moved it off the foreground at exactly 600 s, which IS the reading.

⚠️ The first draft of this row pinned the case count (1534) after rejecting the rider's drifting "about 13 minutes". **A merge from `main` within the same hour moved that count to 1552** — measured, twice, on this branch. A figure that a routine merge falsifies in under an hour has no business in a lookup table, so the landed row names only the cap, which does not drift:

```
- `check:pm-dispatch-gates` 逾容器 600 秒前台上限 ⇒ detach 加 `tail --pid` 前台等;超时不是读数。
```

⭐ A detached run is NOT sufficient on its own, and this is why the row prescribes both halves. A first attempt started with `setsid nohup ... &` died at ~4 minutes having printed 1393 of its cases and **no verdict line** — exactly the shape that reads like a hang. Every completing run was blocked on with `tail --pid`.

**Rider 8 — CONFIRMED at n=5 more, and its second half is new.** One `list_pull_requests` state=closed, `fields` naming `merged`, `merged_at`, `merged_by`, `labels`, `assignees`, `requested_reviewers`, perPage 5: all five rows read `merged: false` with `merged_at` populated (16731, 16724, 16723, 16719, 16705), and `merged_by` — requested by name, and necessarily non-empty on a merged PR — **is absent from every row**. `requested_reviewers` came back on exactly one row, so an empty field is omitted rather than returned empty. Landed as: an absent field is not a value reading.

**Rider 5 — re-measured, and stronger than filed.** The same `list_pull_requests` call returned full `labels` on all five PR rows, and a `search_pull_requests` call returned full label objects on five more. Two working legs, not one.

## 4. Line accounting — 395 → 402

Seven landed rows at one line per deduplicated reading, `一事一行`, every line at or under 120 bytes (file max after the change: 120 bytes, zero lines over; the ledger already carried pre-existing rows at exactly 120).

**ONE correction is paid IN PLACE and buys nothing:** the PR-label block's opening row, which read `PR 标签的三条读腿全盲、两条静默` — with leg ④ now answering, that framing would have sent a reader to the payload fallback past a working instrument. It now scopes the blindness to the issue-shaped legs and points at the native endpoints.

⚠️ Nothing was paid by re-wrap: the fourth increment MEASURED zero line-neutral folds among this file's adjacent rule pairs, and re-wrap funding is refused per the 2026-08-17 rule in any case.

The ceiling row moves 395 → 402 with a new `ruledRaises` record quoting the standing exception verbatim, dated 2026-09-08, **delta 7**. Gate verdict lines:

```
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md is 402 lines (ceiling 402; headroom 0).
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: cross-file move into .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md: +11 (314→402, less 77 lines of ordinary ruled raise) against a net source decrease of 20
```

The move's own raise is unchanged at **+11** — which is the whole point of recording the increment as a ruled raise rather than carrying `was` forward.

## 5. Gates — 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT MEASURED

The dispatch's list was 16, derived before the ratchet script was in the file surface; re-derived inside the worktree it is **38**. Re-run in full on the final merged tree:

```
Run reconciliation — 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
```

All 38 exit 0, including `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 1552 cases pass.` (0 failures). Three worth naming:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` exited **3 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET** on a fresh worktree, two packages unbuilt. That is NOT a finding and NOT a red; cleared by building them under the shared verify lock and re-run to **exit 0**.
- `check-governed-merges --test` exits **3 GOVERNED** by design, as quoted at the top.
- The reconciliation was re-derived twice after **STALE TREE** warnings — the tool refused to let a derivation stand on a tree behind `origin/main` whose own derivation files had moved. Both times the fix was to merge `main` and derive again.

Every exit code was captured before any pipe (`cmd > log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`), never through one.

The ratchet script has no separate test file — `git grep` for its name under tests finds only an audit document. Its test surface is its own `--self-test`, which `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` runs ahead of the gate in the same script; both legs are in the exit 0 above.

## 6. Mergeability and changeset

`origin/main` at `8b37a0973`, merged into this branch; head `d96ad3037`. Neither merge touched either changed file (`git log` on those paths across the range is empty — a `git diff` between the tips shows them only because this branch's own edits are on one side), and neither left an `os-regen` deferral. Merge-tree probe from a throwaway bare clone with **no** merge driver registered, as AGENTS.md requires:

```
git --git-dir=PROBE.git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only 8b37a0973 d96ad3037
→ exit 0, tree 722f63d652d482cda580f181ccc7a6465a7776d8, no conflicted paths
```

`skip-changeset`: both paths publish nothing. `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` are on the not-published fast track — no package `files[]` ships either.

## 7. Acceptance notes — out of scope, filed and not filed

**Filed: issue 16762** — while taking the control read above, both qualifier-shaped `search_issues` queries returned the EXACT label-filtered population (5/5 and 17/17 against the deterministic channel), where the ledger records that a qualifier form answers `total_count: 0`. Deliberately NOT written onto the ledger here: the ledger's own rows record that this tool's failures are SESSION-scoped, so a healthy session is no more a fleet-wide fact than a broken one was. That is a card and a second session's re-measure, not an edit — and the standing prohibition is cheap to obey meanwhile. Dedup ran first: five related cards, all closed, none covering it.

**Noted, not filed** — MCP `create_pull_request` appended a SECOND session-URL footer under a rule line to a body that already carried one; the ledger records that append shape only for bare REST `POST /pulls`, and its own row warns the shape varies by channel AND action. A candidate for the NEXT increment; not landed here because it changes no prescription (the standing "read the body back after writing" rule already covers it). Carrier: the next author of that footer row.

**Noted, not filed** — PM's mechanism assumption 2 is falsified: there is no "write path" section in the ledger (zero hits for both spellings; positive control 写侧 hits 11). The file has exactly five sections, and PR 16701 did not add one. Lines were placed by the existing structure instead. Carrier: this PR's reviewer, who would otherwise look for a section that does not exist. Assumption 3 held — the CEILINGS row is the sole source of the ceiling; the other `395` literals in `scripts/` belong to an unrelated docs count and an anchor surface.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 两个文件。平台读数账本加 7 行、原地改写 1 行(395 → 402);棘轮脚本里该文件的上限行跟着抬到落地行数,并按常设裁决补一条 `ruledRaises` 记录(delta 7)。没有代码改动,没有发布物。

**为什么改** — 链首那张卡要求先复测「单标签列举会漏项」这条一次性观察,复测**没有复现**,所以它一行都没写(卡片自己就是这么定的)。真正落地的是同一批次里已去重的 6 条平台读数,加上成员卡那条标题截断的新行:尖括号的丢失在**读侧**、也影响**标题**、而且是**从首个标签形跨度切到结尾**——不是缺个洞,是被截断,读上去仍像一句完整的标题,所以凭标题做的总体计数只是下界。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 风险低:改的是给 agent 看的操作手册,不进构建产物、不影响运行时,`skip-changeset` 成立。代价是账本长了 7 行,上限抬到 402、余量归零,下次增量仍要按同样纪律付账。回滚就是 revert 这一个 PR,两个文件一起回到 395,棘轮会自己变绿——没有数据迁移、没有下游依赖。

⚠️ 两处请您留意,都是飞行中被**推翻过一次**的判断,已按复核结论改正:① 成员卡最初是「原地改写」交付,复核指出那样会让原句失去主语(到底丢的是什么),现已把原句**逐字节还原**、标题事实另起一行,账因此从 +6 变成 +7;② 曾按上游指示写入第 10 条候选(说请审调用会把治理面草稿翻成 ready),上游随后查证是**人工 actor 的批准**造成的翻转并撤回,该行连同它改写的补救行已完整还原。另外第 1 条读数里我一度把用例数 1534 写进账本,一次 merge 就把它变成 1552,所以最终那行只留「逾 600 秒前台上限」这个不会漂的事实。

**席位意见** — (留空,待席位复核填写)

**你要做的** — 这是受管面(`.claude/**`),按 Prime Directive #14,**只能由您手工合并**:任何 agent 都不会把它转 ready、不会入队、不会挂 auto-merge。您需要做的就是读一遍第 1 节的复测读数(尤其「没复现」这个结论您认不认)、第 2 节还原后的那一对行、第 3 节的去重判定表,以及第 4 节的行数账;认可就手工合并,不认可就直接在 PR 上说哪一条要撤。
